scene: A slate rooftop above a harbour town at night, chimneys and a church spire, the sea glittering beyond

subjects.description: A young woman with long red braided hair, pale freckled skin and a dark green hooded wool cloak, hood up
subjects.position: right third, silhouetted against the sky
subjects.action: crouching at the roof edge, looking down into the street
subjects.pose: low crouch on one knee, one hand on the slates, profile view facing left

style: painterly cinematic concept art, visible brush texture, storyboard key frame
lighting: cold moonlight from above left as key, warm window light from the street below as rim on her face
background: moonlit clouds, a weathervane, smoke from a chimney, harbour lights in the distance
composition: medium shot, strong diagonal of the roof ridge, negative space of sky on the left

camera.angle: low angle, from the roof surface
camera.depth_of_field: shallow, town lights as soft bokeh
